question: Among all non-carcinogenic molecules that contain triple bonds, what is the percentage of molecules that have chlorine atoms? Also, calculate the average number of triple bonds per molecule in this subset.

prediction.sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    INNER JOIN molecule m ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#' AND m.XCL_011 = '-'
),
triple_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS triple_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules t ON b.XCL_005 = t.molecule_id
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
    GROUP BY b.XCL_005
),
chlorine_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules t ON a.XCL_002 = t.molecule_id
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'cl'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(c.molecule_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t.molecule_id) AS percentage_with_chlorine,
    AVG(tb.triple_bond_count) AS avg_triple_bonds_per_molecule
FROM triple_bond_molecules t
LEFT JOIN chlorine_molecules c ON t.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN triple_bond_counts tb ON t.molecule_id = tb.molecule_id

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    INNER JOIN molecule m ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#' AND m.XCL_011 = '-'
),
triple_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS triple_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules t ON b.XCL_005 = t.molecule_id
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
    GROUP BY b.XCL_005
),
chlorine_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules t ON a.XCL_002 = t.molecule_id
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'cl'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(c.molecule_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t.molecule_id) AS percentage_with_chlorine,
    AVG(tb.triple_bond_count) AS avg_triple_bonds_per_molecule
FROM triple_bond_molecules t
LEFT JOIN chlorine_molecules c ON t.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN triple_bond_counts tb ON t.molecule_id = tb.molecule_id

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT m.XCL_010,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN b.XCL_006 = '#' THEN 1 END) AS triple_bond_count,
           MAX(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_cl
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN b.XCL_006 = '#' THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(has_cl) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_with_chlorine,
    AVG(triple_bond_count) AS avg_triple_bonds
FROM qualifying

chlorine_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules t ON a.XCL_002 = t.molecule_id
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'cl'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(c.molecule_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t.molecule_id) AS percentage_with_chlorine,
    AVG(tb.triple_bond_count) AS avg_triple_bonds_per_molecule
FROM triple_bond_molecules t
LEFT JOIN chlorine_molecules c ON t.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN triple_bond_counts tb ON t.molecule_id = tb.molecule_id
